technology_name: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF SOLAR PV-T HEAT PUMP BASED WATER HEATING WITH UNIFORM PV COOLING AND ENHANCED HOT WATER OUTPUT
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Photovoltaic panels overheat under heavy insulation, which sharply degrades their solar electrical power conversion efficiency and wastes structural heat output.
description: An integrated solar photovoltaic-thermal (PV-T) water heating system equipped with a PV module array, a bottom absorber plate, a variable frequency drive (VFD) compressor loop, a condenser tank, and active uniform cooling micro-channels.
applications: Residential solar cogeneration installations, commercial building hot water networks, eco-friendly district heating systems, and industrial pre-heating utilities.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Water, Environment & Waste Management
